title: Product Designer (Platform)
profile: Product and UX/UI Designer with 2 years of in-house industry experience designing internal business platforms, including HRMS modules for HR administrators and managers and a Partner Portal with dashboards and workflows, supported by an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University and a Bachelor of Technology in Computer Science. Experienced in turning business requirements into clear, structured workflows, mapping end-to-end user flows, and designing with reusable UI patterns and high-fidelity interfaces in Figma. Works closely with product stakeholders and developers, keeping design feasibility and the needs of everyday operational users in view.
